entities.summary: Mehdi Golshani is an Iranian theoretical physicist, and a distinguished professor at Sharif University of Technology. He is a member of the Iranian Science and Culture Hall of Fame, a senior fellow of the Academy of Sciences of Iran and a founding fellow of the Institute for Studies in Theoretical Physics and Mathematics. He is a former member of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution.
